authorization_scope: Independent exploratory analysis requested by the user on 26 October 2026; no coauthor sign-off is asserted.
public_capture_scope: Four public A549 profiles plus eleven bounded source metadata files; no verification/replacement of the original private twelve-file bundle or completed U2OS result.
primary_endpoint: Finite-cohort mean cosine difference between same recorded source-gene/different-recorded-DNA partners and balanced other-source-gene references.
relationship_status: Provisional source annotations only; no reviewed guide/target identity, efficacy, off-target absence or independent culture is inferred.
guide_grouping: Identical recorded DNA strings collapse across reagent aliases; exact reagent, identical DNA and reverse-complement DNA matches are conservatively excluded from comparisons.
identity_holds: Missing, multigene/ambiguous sequence associations and well-like gene strings including F10 remain in accounting but are held from labeled cross-guide relationships. This does not assert that F10 is an invalid biological gene.
primary_mask: different physical plate and different canonical row AND different canonical column
secondary_mask: different physical plate and different canonical coordinate
reference_weighting: Equal source gene, then recorded sequence group, then physical well after masking; all treatment gallery rows retained in flow accounting.
effect_weighting: Existing canonical helper: complete guide pair supports both guide directions in every ordered plate comparison; equal wells/cells, directions, six unordered physical plate pairs, guide pairs within source gene, then source genes.
qcs: Nonfinite and zero-norm vectors remain in denominators, have unavailable cosine and cannot yield fabricated zero effects. No imputation, learned scaler, feature selection or training.
preprocessing_interpretation: Conditional on provided source-preprocessed vectors; original fit population and artifact-specific execution binding remain unverified. No inductive or leakage-free preprocessing claim.
position_control: Same morphology-valid comparison observations and weights, fixed coordinate score 1 - 0.5*(absolute row difference/15 + absolute column difference/23). Report side by side; no causal adjustment or score-scale equivalence claim.
query_information: New field-signature audit on unique treatment reagent IDs. Category-only uses pert_type/control_type/negcon_control_type; gene-aware adds the literal recorded gene. No historical V1/V2 renderer or model is run.
uncertainty: Finite-cohort distributions only. No confidence interval, permutation p-value or independent culture/population inference.
multiplicity: Same frozen primary endpoint and declared spatial sensitivity as U2OS; report every native eligible A549 group without favorable selection. Three analyses share one cohort and are not independent replications. Cross-context differences are not causal effects.
publication: Code, synthetic tests and protocol may be pushed to a draft research branch. Real-data outputs remain local and are not automatically committed or published.
compute: Local CPU only; no Biowulf allocation, private-data transfer, GPU/model run or collaborator contact.
stop_conditions: duplicate physical wells or contradictory joins
no eligible comparison population (report unavailable, never fabricate a score)
study_context: A549/Cas9 CRISPR, 144 h, density 100%, antibiotics absent, Day0, first imaging, anomaly none
selection_timing: Selected after the completed U2OS exploratory result. All eligible native A549 source-gene groups are included without selection using observed morphology or favorable gene names.
relation_to_previous_study: Second recorded cell context within the same source batch and fixed reagent layout; not an untouched independent-batch test and not an isolated WGA or cell-type intervention. U2OS and A549 are not pooled.

amendment.reason: The v1 384-profile-rows-per-plate assumption failed before scoring. Plate capacity does not establish available profile rows.
amendment.row_policy: Keep every observed unique valid well in each of four nonempty bounded files. Bind actual per-plate counts, ordered schema and full-grid absence census before numeric conversion. Never impute absent profile rows.
amendment.missingness_cause: Unverified; not assumed random, QC failure, cell death or acquisition failure.
amendment.denominators: Report the 1536-position physical grid separately from observed-profile eligibility. No full-grid biological recovery claim.

freeze_boundary: Before numeric feature conversion/scoring; source CSV field strings are parsed during the metadata-only census.
